title: 第15章 登峰造极境第16章 天雷鹰图
slug: 八岁开始模拟的我觉醒重瞳
lines: 【第一百零八年，你境界提升到了会元境后期。
【第一百零九年，你领悟了大成的蜉蝣刀意，你的黄级中品武技蜉蝣踏前斩达到了登峰造极之境。
这一刻，你的灵魂整个都感觉得到了升华，而在修炼成功大成的蜉蝣刀意后，以前对你来说，只有半道门槛，却怎么都无法跨过去的大成憾山拳意，也被你感知到了。
这一刻，你明白，你距离大成的憾山拳意也只是时间问题。
【在闭关突破成功后，你出门去见了李芙蓉，多年未见的两人久别胜新欢，感情比以前要更加要好。
但在持续两天后，李芙蓉有些吃不消了，对此你一点不意外，难得的感觉此刻的自己，特别的男人。
自从有着大成的蜉蝣刀意后，你能感觉到自己身体的力量，与其他各项基础值有了巨大的提升，虽然还只是会元境后期，但身体强度已然可以比拟地元境。
但论真实实力，你使用蜉蝣踏前斩的大成刀意与敌人战斗，即使是地元境后期强者，你都有把握能过几招。
【妻子李芙蓉才在不久前突破到会元境初期，她的身体素质自然无法与你相比，即使是田，在牛强大到一定程度的时候，也有被耕坏的时候。
【同年，你回到了叶家，找到了叶家的三位老祖，得知了你蜉蝣踏前斩突破到登峰造极境界的情况，他们同意了你的请求。
拿到了叶家老祖交给你由玄级极品稀有材料，制作而成的百世玉简后，你花费了十五日时间把自己的心得与体会都刻录了进去。
【整个叶家，也只有初代老祖留下的憾山拳百世玉简，这册玉简只有叶家嫡系子弟才有资格观看，也是因为这个玉简，叶家弟子对于憾山拳的理解提升，非其他武技能比拟。
虽然对于武技领悟大成意境不会有什么帮助，却也是整个家族的传承之物，可以作为家族底蕴，极为珍贵。
而你记录下来的蜉蝣踏前斩百世玉简，并不是免费记录，家族会给予你一定贡献，这种特殊贡献，即可以换取宝库中的资源，也可以在有些时候起到作用。
【第一百一十七年，你的儿媳找到你，希望你能够出面，帮助雪山派进入特殊的小型秘境获取资源，并表示事后会给予你很大一笔资源。
雪山派掌控了一个小型的特殊秘境，这在一些势力中并不是什么秘密，而叶家也是知道这个消息的势力。
以雪山派太上长老虚神境的实力，也没有人胆敢抢夺这个小型的特殊秘境。
【据儿媳讲述，这个小型秘境与叶家控制的特殊微型秘境不同，秘境需要五百年才会开启一次，最高只能进入会元境的武者，恰好她清楚你就是一位会元境后期武者，同时有着两种融会贯通的黄级武技，实力比普通的会元境武者要强不少。
而只要你能愿意进入这个秘境帮助雪山派获取天材地宝，无论成功与否，她都能获得一份门派贡献。
content_en:
[In the 108th year, your realm has been promoted to the late stage of Huiyuan realm.
[In the 109th year, you comprehended Dacheng’s Mayfly Sword Intent, and your yellow-level middle-grade martial art Mayfly Slash has reached its peak.
At this moment, your soul feels as if it has been sublimated, and after successfully cultivating the Dacheng's Mayfly Blade Intention, you can also feel the Dacheng Hanshan Fist Intention, which was only half a threshold for you but could not cross it no matter what.
At this moment, you understand that it is only a matter of time before you are able to achieve the ultimate goal of Shanshan Quanyi.
[After you successfully broke through the seclusion, you went out to meet Li Furong. The two of you who hadn't seen each other for many years became a new love after a long separation, and their relationship was even better than before.
But after two days, Li Furong couldn't take it anymore. You weren't surprised at all. It was a rare feeling that you were a special man at this moment.
Since possessing the great success of the Mayfly Sword Intent, you can feel the strength of your body and other basic values ​​​​have been greatly improved. Although you are still in the late stage of the Huiyuan Realm, your physical strength is already comparable to the Earth Yuan Realm.
But in terms of real strength, if you use Mayfly's Dacheng Sword Intent to fight the enemy, even a strong person in the late Earth Yuan realm, you are sure to be able to defeat a few moves.
[My wife Li Furong just broke through to the early stage of Huiyuan Realm not long ago. Her physical fitness is naturally incomparable to yours. Even the fields will sometimes be destroyed when the cattle are strong enough.
[In the same year, you returned to the Ye family and found the three ancestors of the Ye family. They learned about your breakthrough to the ultimate realm with Mayfly Stepping Forward, and they agreed to your request.
After you received the century-old jade slip made from Xuan-level rare materials handed to you by the ancestor of the Ye family, you spent fifteen days inscribing all your thoughts and experiences into it.
[The entire Ye family only has the Jade Slip of Hanshan Quan that has been passed down by the first ancestor. Only direct descendants of the Ye family are qualified to view this jade slip. It is also because of this jade slip that the disciples of the Ye family have improved their understanding of Hanshan Fist in a way that is unmatched by other martial arts skills.
Although it will not be of any help to the understanding of martial arts and the artistic conception of Dacheng, it is also an inheritance of the entire family. It can be used as family heritage and is extremely precious.
The record you recorded of Mayfly Stomping on the Jade Slip of a Century is not a free record. Your family will give you a certain contribution. This special contribution can be exchanged for resources in the treasure house, and it can also play a role sometimes.
[In the 117th year, your daughter-in-law found you and hoped that you would come forward to help the Snow Mountain Sect enter a special small secret realm to obtain resources. She also said that she would give you a large amount of resources afterwards.
The Snow Mountain Sect controls a small special secret realm. This is not a secret among some forces, and the Ye family is also a force that knows the news.
With the strength of the Xueshan Sect Supreme Elder in the Virtual God Realm, no one dares to snatch this small special secret realm.
[According to my daughter-in-law, this small secret realm is different from the special miniature secret realm controlled by the Ye family. It takes five hundred years to open the secret realm. The highest level can only be entered by Huiyuan realm warriors. She happens to know that you are a late-stage Huiyuan realm warrior. You have two well-integrated yellow-level martial arts, and your strength is much stronger than ordinary Huiyuan realm warriors.
And as long as you are willing to enter this secret realm to help the Snow Mountain Sect obtain heavenly materials and earthly treasures, no matter whether you succeed or not, she will get a share of the sect's contribution.
